context.transcript:
To end this meeting, I'd like to thank you all for filling out the survey about the company cafeteria that was distributed a few months ago.
There were many comments about the amount of food from the prepackaged meals that was being thrown away.
We've almost eliminated that problem by adding a new self-serve area in the cafeteria.
Now, before you leave, our executive chef has created some new recipes that she'd like us to try.
Please take some samples on your way out of the room.
context.transcript_translation:
为了结束本次会议，我想感谢大家几个月前填写的公司食堂调查问卷。
很多人对预包装餐食浪费掉的食物数量提出了许多评论。
通过在食堂增加一个新的自助区域，我们几乎消除了这个问题。
现在，在您离开之前，我们的行政主厨创建了一些新的食谱，希望我们能试一下。
请在离开房间的路上拿一些样品。
